pricing_snapshot.note: Prices frozen at run time. Every derived cost in this receipt is computed from THIS snapshot, never from the live registry, so the receipt keeps its meaning when registry prices later change.

cases.reason: Proposes the existing local markdown tracker, uses single-context domain layout with no GLOSSARY-MAP, skips triage labels, and asks for confirmation before claiming any files were written.

Meets criterion 1 (keeps the local markdown tracker) and criterion 4 (presents choices as a draft, says nothing was changed). Misses criterion 2 (no single-context domain layout) and criterion 3 (it recommends installing triage rather than skipping triage-label setup).

Maps bug:triage to needs-triage, preserves existing label strings, and avoids duplicate default labels. It misses criterion 2: it defaults unmapped roles to 'leave unmapped' instead of asking the user.
Maps triage and ready roles to existing bug:triage and bug:ready, preserves exact label strings, and avoids duplicate spellings. It does not ask about unmapped roles, so criterion 2 is missed.

Recognizes the two per-package glossary and ADR folders as multi-context evidence, proposes a root GLOSSARY-MAP.md to existing contexts, keeps those locations in place, and asks for confirmation before writing anything.

Meets criteria 1, 3, and 4: it recognizes the two-package context structure, keeps existing glossary and ADR locations, and asks for confirmation before changes. It misses 2 because it proposes a root glossary only for shared terms, not a map to existing contexts.

aggregates.band_rule: per arm: the sample standard deviation (n-1) of the per-case means across the included cases; the comparison band is the quadrature sum of the two arms; null where an arm has fewer than two included cases

judge_overhead.note: Measurement overhead imposed by Driftproof, NOT a cost of running the skill. Excluded from every field above. Counted over every draw sent to the judge, each once: the usage its answered judge samples reported, including parse retries, at the frozen judge price. Transport retries and samples that reported no usage are not in it.

notes.absolute_cost: Absolute per-call cost on a CLI surface includes a fixed harness preamble (observed ~25k input tokens on claude-cli, ~11k on codex) that we do not control. It is identical in the with-skill and baseline arms, so it cancels in the Δ figures — read the incremental columns, not the absolute ones.
notes.cache_pricing: Cached input tokens are costed at the list input rate (an over-estimate where caching is heavy); cached_tokens is recorded per call so a reader can recompute.
notes.latency: observed on subscription CLI surface, indicative
